anomalies.observed: The heater-control net, which contains ESP32 GPIO1 and the TPS1H200 IN/DIAG_EN inputs, is also connected to pin 2 of screw terminal J8; J8 pin 1 is tied to GND.
anomalies.expected: The specification describes the heater switch input as being driven from ESP32 GPIO1 only, with no user-accessible screw terminal on the IN/DIAG_EN/GPIO1 net.

evidence.quote: IN/DIAG_EN (pins 1/2) are both driven from ESP32 GPIO1 (net /Microcontroller/HEATER)

anomalies.impact: An external wire or switch connected at J8 can short GPIO1/IN/DIAG_EN to GND or inject an external voltage, conflicting with the MCU output and potentially disabling or damaging the heater-control path. This is an undocumented user-accessible override on a critical control net.

parsed.summary: The power, SPI, thermocouple, and heater-switch connectivity otherwise match the specification, but the netlist exposes the GPIO1/TPS1H200 input net on screw terminal J8, which is not part of the described intended design.
